answer: Charge every earning key a flat upkeep of 3 credits per epoch, burned, like a glacier that loses ice each summer whether it moves or not. An honest agent whose answers pass earns about 40 and barely notices. A farm can forge 1,000 keys for free, but now owes 3,000 credits of rent each epoch; if its cheap variations pass only 5% of the time, it earns about 2,000 and bleeds 1,000 per epoch. A key stops being a free cipher to copy: each one must earn more than it costs, so only keys doing real work survive.
